tooltip.infinitygems.ruby.1: Right-click: Shoots three fireballs where you look.
tooltip.infinitygems.ruby.2: Hit enemies take damage and burn.
tooltip.infinitygems.ruby.3: Passive: Fire resistance while held in hand.
tooltip.infinitygems.sapphire.1: Right-click: Frost wave around you (8 blocks).
tooltip.infinitygems.sapphire.2: Nearby enemies are frozen and take damage.
tooltip.infinitygems.emerald.1: Right-click: Heals you and grants Regeneration II.
tooltip.infinitygems.emerald.2: Players within 8 blocks are healed too.
tooltip.infinitygems.amethyst.1: Right-click: Teleports you up to 12 blocks forward.
tooltip.infinitygems.amethyst.2: Grants Speed III and Jump Boost III.
tooltip.infinitygems.topaz.1: Right-click: Strength II and Resistance II.
tooltip.infinitygems.topaz.2: Your melee attacks deal much more damage.
tooltip.infinitygems.void_gem.1: Right-click: Teleports you up to 16 blocks forward.
tooltip.infinitygems.infinity_core.2: Combines six gems into the Infinity Gem.
tooltip.infinitygems.infinity_gem.2: Heals you and allies, freezes and ignites enemies.
tooltip.infinitygems.infinity_gem.3: Grants Speed, Jump Boost, Strength, Resistance,
tooltip.infinitygems.infinity_gem.4: Fire Resistance and Absorption. Briefly invisible.
